ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-1,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-E in the
area bound by:

East 114" Place; a line 50.32 feet west of and parallel to South Prairie Avenue; East
115 Street; and South Prairie Avenue,

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Lah Slt Boze
a
Anthony A. Beale
Alderman, 9" Ward

Common Address:
234 E. 115" Street
